checked.how: Traced: game passes TRACKS (sorted by file name: bramble-bends, dust-bowl, hay-loop) mapped to {id,name,outline}. Each becomes a role=radio card inside a radiogroup labelled 'Select track', under an h2 'SELECT TRACK'. outlinePath gives 'M…L…Z'. The start--menu screenshot shows the three cards in order with outlines.

checked.target: AC2 stored best per card (best-laps.ts, track-card.ts setBest, format.ts)
checked.how: refreshBests runs at construction and on every show(). read() wraps getItem in try/catch and parse() rejects non-finite and ≤0 values, so both give NO_TIME. formatTime(40370) gives '0:40.37'. A throwing store only yields null, so the menu still renders.

checked.target: AC3 single selection, click, arrow wrap (start-screen.ts pick/keydown)
checked.how: pick() sets aria-checked on every card, so exactly one is true. The initial selection is TRACKS[0], re-selected via showMenu (menuTrack). A click calls pick(id,true). Arrow keys step ±1 modulo cards.length, which wraps at both ends. keyboard.ts listens on window and doesn't stopPropagation.

checked.target: AC4 Hay Loop race + quit keeps selection, RACE focused (game.ts:108-124,147,271-305; dom.ts overlay)
checked.how: onRace calls enterRace(selected()), which calls startRace with carCount PLAYER_CAR_COUNT (6). startRace sets menuTrack=track. showMenu calls select(menuTrack.id) and then overlay show(), which focuses RACE. The cards aren't buttons, so RACE is the first button.

StartScreen.show() calls refreshBests() before screen.show(), and showMenu calls it. race-ui.ts:131 writes racer.bestLap.<id> on each lap during sync, so playtest step 5 (lap finished, then quit) shows the new best.
The brand div holds the h1 (Daily / AI Racer), stripes() (red, mustard, cream) and the titleCar svg with role=img and aria-label 'Player car #1'. All are visible in the start--menu screenshot.

onQuit plays 'stripes' and then calls showMenu (immediate). RACE/RETRY/NEXT RACE use enterRace, which plays 'chequer'. The overlay is removed after wipe+2×stagger tokens (330ms). Direct game.startRace and showMenu add none. A missing matchMedia counts as motion allowed.

Viewed the start--menu, menu-selected, screen-change stripes and chequer screenshots: navy title panel with the #1 car, dirt panel with 3 cards (outline, name, BEST or dashes), mustard selected card, red RACE, stripe sweep over the menu, chequer band over the race.
